adapter: LoRA adapter, pilot v8, trained on data-v3.2 (NOT a merged model)

layout.base: cyberLLMv1/base/ — full Qwen3-1.7B files at the pinned revision
layout.manifest: cyberLLMv1/manifest.json — this file, tracked in Git; weights are NOT tracked

notes: Environment variables override this manifest: CYBERLLM_BASE_MODEL, CYBERLLM_BASE_REVISION, CYBERLLM_ADAPTER_SHA256, CYBERLLM_MODEL_ROOT, CYBERLLM_BASE_DIR, CYBERLLM_ADAPTER_DIR.
Do NOT substitute another base revision or an adapter_17b_datav2_* file (pilot v4) or adapter_datav2_* file (pilot v3, 0.6B fallback).
Base download is about 4.1 GB; adapter is about 82 MB; combined about 4.2 GB.
